title: ADAM LZ WILL NOT RETURN TO FORMULA DRIFT IN 2027

headline: ADAM LZ
WON'T RETURN
TO FD IN 2027
data.body: Adam LZ announced on the podium at the Long Beach finale, after taking third, that he will not be back in Formula DRIFT in 2027. He finished his last season 12th in the standings in the LZMFG BMW E36. He explains why in his own video, Why I Quit Formula Drift.

check_reason: aankondiging gecontroleerd via fan-upload van de livestream en Wikipedia (P3 LB2, 12e in stand); eigen video van LZ niet zelf bekeken, nieuws is van 25 okt
